title: FireGenerators
subtitle: AI financial literacy & investing coach
problem: Beginners don't know their own financial level, so they get advice that's too easy or too hard.
built: Designed and built an adaptive OX / multiple-choice level test whose difficulty shifts with accuracy and response time
GPT-5 reads the answers and writes a 3-sentence report: strengths, weak spots, and what to learn next
Offline evaluation pipeline for question-difficulty calibration and report quality, iterating on prompts
User profile schema in Supabase that feeds content curation and stock/ETF recommendations
result: Shipped the full flow from adaptive level test → personal GPT-5 report → recommendations, and used the offline evaluation pipeline to make the reports more reliable and consistent.
noDemoNote: No live demo — the repo README has screenshots.

title: EatWise
subtitle: OCR product info & price comparison
summary: Photo of an electronic shelf label → rotation fix & denoise → OCR → Gemini turns it into product & nutrition JSON → compare the lowest price online.
proof: Benchmarked PaddleOCR vs EasyOCR with Character Error Rate (CER)
note: a photo is the input → pipeline
